judgments.supporting_quote: Indicators are to be provided to show whether the valves are open or closed.
Vent outlets are to be fitted with corrosion resistant flame-screens.
Fit and fasten rear cover and/or motor bracket... in the pump casing.
In places where oil spray or leakage can occur, the insulation material is not to be of the oil-absorbing type unless encased in metal sheets or equivalent
